messages.subject: Use of Wallace in courses/workshops
messages.body_plain:
Dear community,

We want to know about the use of Wallace.
If you have used Wallace in a course or workshop, please let us know. If possible, please include: name/s of instructor/s, institution, city, country, month/year, level of students, and number of students.

Thanks,
Wallace dev-team

messages.subject: Re: Use of Wallace in courses/workshops
messages.body_plain:
Hello Wallace team,

I recently conducted a workshop on Wallace at Universidad Nacional Autonoma de Honduras en al Valle de Sula. San Pedro Sula, Honduras. For the“Patterns of diversification and evolution of Honduran Amphibians: Challenges, Advances, and Opportunities” symposium (June 2019). I am a Masters student at Indiana University of Pennsylvania in the Dr. Joe Townsend lab. The workshop was given to the entire biology faculty at UNAH-VS and some undergrads, just about 25 people.

Thanks for all the work you do on Wallace!

-Justin O'Neill

messages.subject: reading wallace models back into R for further analysis or visualization
messages.subject_clean: reading wallace models back into R for further analysis or visualization
messages.body_plain:
1) Is there a way to import our wallace-produced model back into an R object, to run analyses in other packages (e.g. niche equivalency in ENMTools)?

2) How can we visualize the output .grd/.gri ENMs in R to produce higher resolution figures?

messages.subject: Re: reading wallace models back into R for further analysis or visualization
messages.subject_clean: reading wallace models back into R for further analysis or visualization
messages.body_plain:
Hi Jocelyn,

1) This option is not available on Wallace. But, once you get your model on the GUI, you can download a markdown in the Session Code tab. This file allows you to re-run your model in R console in where you can add others analyses.

2) There is plenty information that can help you to visualize raters in R. Maybe some of these links can help you:
https://www.neonscience.org/dc-plot-raster-data-rn
https://rblogzef.wordpress.com/2014/05/12/raster-visualization-with-r/

Best,
Gonzalo

messages.subject_clean: critical crash error: Error in leadNamespace: there is no package called 'geoaxe'
messages.body_plain:
Dear Illustrious developers and community -

We are leading a workshop in Vietnam and one of our participants who is running R 3.6.1 on a MacBook Air with the newest OS, and she keeps getting a critical error that crashes wallace in module 1 (query GBIF). Wallace goes grey and crashes and in R studio, the error reads:

Warning: Error in loadNamespace: there is no package called 'geoaxe'

but when we try to install geoaxe there is no such package...
